statement: The US Senate passes the Clarity Act (digital asset market structure legislation) via a floor vote held between 2026-09-15 and 2026-09-17, the scheduled window for the make-or-break vote reported on 14 September 2026.
resolution: TRUE if the Congress.gov or Senate.gov roll call record shows the Clarity Act passed the Senate on any day between 2026-09-15 and 2026-09-17. FALSE if it fails, is not brought to a vote in that window, or is postponed beyond 2026-09-17.
failure_condition: The Congress.gov roll call record shows the Clarity Act did not pass the Senate between 2026-09-15 and 2026-09-17, whether by a failed vote, no vote held, or postponement beyond that window.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.
